segments.en: [inaudible]
Hello, hello.
I am from Ernakulam.
What do you do?
I work at a car showroom.
Is there no work there?
I have some urgent work, so I am leaving. I will come after 10 o'clock.
Okay. Where are you calling from?
I am from Guruvayur.
Guruvayur? What do you do?
I am a Thirumeni.
You are a Thirumeni?
Yes, can't you see?
Are you a Jyothishi?
No, no, no. Nothing like that. I don't have any work related to that.
What is your name, actually?
My name is Sharanya.
Where is your place exactly?
Pathanamthitta.
I work in Ernakulam.
Where do you stay?
Here in Ernakulam.
Is it a hostel? Where do you stay, in a hostel?
No, no, this is an apartment.
In which temple is Shanthi?
There is nothing in the temple now. I am old, so I don't have any fever or anything.
I go occasionally, if there is any program.
Oh, so you know Jyothisham?
No, no, no, no.
Is Jyothisham your work?
I have plenty of work.
Oh, some people say that... can I ask you one thing?
Is Koodu-pathram, Koodu-pathram, is that all fake or true?
I don't know. I don't know about that, so I will say I don't know. I don't know about Koodu-pathram or anything.
I don't know anything about that.
That's not what I asked. My brother... I have a brother, my elder brother.
He got married, but not in a very good way.
It's not Koodu-pathram, it's Koodu-othram.
Ah, that's it, that's it.
That girl's family... for me and my mother...
Some people have experience, I am saying. Maybe it happened, maybe not.
My brother's life is completely ruined.
Just call God, pray to God. That's all you can do.
But there is another thing, my brother's job is here in Hyderabad.
He is set up with a girl there, and that girl has a child there.
The wife there, my sister-in-law, is Hidumbi, she is at that girl's house.
She went there and got set up, right?
That girl is not needed, the brother is not needed. It's just standing legally, that's all.
Okay.
So what will you do?
What to do? Tell God, pray well, chant the name every day. That's what you should do.
Tell your brother, tell your family members. That is the main thing.
My brother doesn't want that girl.
If he doesn't want her, pray to get rid of her. Pray that it becomes right.
Pray to God.
No, Thirumeni, if she leaves, she won't leave. That girl needs money.
She is asking for a huge amount.
What I am saying is, we cannot make it right. We should pray to God to make it right, and help us.
I am a Hindu. I am a Hindu. Which is the best God in Hinduism?
There is nothing like that. Every God is good. I won't say one God is good and another is bad. Every God is good. You should have faith in God.
That's all.
But I have only one God. When I look, there is only one God, that is a human.
Then you should go with your faith. Don't go with blind faith, go with your faith.
No, God will never come directly in front of us, he will only come in the form of a human.
That's all.
God will never come directly in front of us. So, we are humans, now, I met Thirumeni. I see Thirumeni here randomly.
So God... I told you about my brother's things, right? So, can I ask you one thing? Now that relationship should end.
The second relationship is a good relationship, my brother is happy.
There is nothing in his house, but when he calls, he is very happy.
But in the first relationship, my brother has a child, a girl child.
In the second relationship, my brother has a boy child.
I don't have any opinion on that. It's good if it ends in a good way.
That's all I have to say.
Going to Jyothishi and wasting money is of no use.
Oh, I and my mother wasted money, and... do you know Hari from Pathanamthitta? He is very famous.
I don't know, I don't know, I don't know.
You don't know? You should know, Thirumeni, you should know.
No.
He did a lot of things. And what about the Plathi people, the Plathi?
I don't know. I don't go behind all that, so I don't know.
Is that so? Okay.
My time is almost up, my money is running out.
Okay, okay.
Are you using WhatsApp?
I have WhatsApp.
